note: Static evaluation definitions. They are not claims that any target runtime/model has passed them.

cases.prompt: This library changed behavior between our pinned version and current stable. Find the real root cause in our repo, verify the version boundary, and fix it with the smallest regression-tested change.
expect: make surgical change only if requested
run or clearly scope regression verification
